text:
Which statement describes a property of ethanoic acid?
A
It does not produce carbon dioxide when added to sodium carbonate.
B
It does not produce hydrogen when added to magnesium.
C
It only donates some of its protons when added to excess aqueous sodium hydroxide.
D
It only partially dissociates when added to water.

options.label: A
options.text: It does not produce carbon dioxide when added to sodium carbonate.

options.label: B
options.text: It does not produce hydrogen when added to magnesium.

options.label: C
options.text: It only donates some of its protons when added to excess aqueous sodium hydroxide.

options.label: D
options.text: It only partially dissociates when added to water.
